/assetmanagement/assetallocationreport.title: Asset Allocation Report
tag: Select a.RowID[SlNo],CONVERT(varchar,a.AllocatedOn,104)[AllocationDate],mb.Alias[AssetID], m.Name[Asset] , d.Name[FromDept],ad.Name[ToDept],ar.Name[Area],wc.Name[WorkCenter],emp.Name[Employee]        from AssetAllocation a left join MaterialBarcode mb on a.BarcodeNo =mb.BarcodeNo left join Material m on mb.Material =m.MatCode left join Department d on a.Department =d.DeptCode left join  Department ad on a.ADepartment=ad.DeptCode left join Area ar on a.Area =ar.AreaCode left join WorkCenter wc on a.WorkCenter =wc.StationCode left join Employee emp on emp.EmpCode =a.Employee

/assetmanagement/assetmaintainancereport.title: Asset Maintainance Report
tag: Select ms.Alias[AssetID], m.Alias[AssetCode],m.Name[Asset],d.Name[Department],ms.LastMaintained,ms.NextMaintaince from MaterialBarcode ms left join Material m on ms.Material =m.MatCode  left join Department d on ms.Department =d.DeptCode

/assetmanagement/assetmasterreport.title: Asset Master Report
tag: Select mty.type, mb.Alias[AssetID], m.Name[Asset] ,d.Name[Department],ar.Name[Area],wc.Name[WorkCenter],emp.Name[Employee],CONVERT(varchar,mb.LastMaintained,104)[LastMaintained],CONVERT(varchar,mb.NextMaintaince,104)[Maintainance DueOn] from MaterialBarcode mb left join Material m on mb.Material =m.MatCode left join Department d on mb.ADepartment=d.DeptCode left join Area ar on mb.Area =ar.AreaCode left join WorkCenter wc on mb.WorkCenter =wc.StationCode left join Employee emp on emp.EmpCode =mb.Employee inner join MaterialCategoryType mty on mb.Type=mty.ID and mty.ID>=500 and mty.ID<600

/himile/inwardreport.title: Goods Reciept Report
tag: Select gh.Alias[GRNCode],gh.GRNDate, l.Name[Vendor],m.Alias[ItemCode],m.Name[Description],gm.ReceivedQty,gm.PrintQty,ih.ApprovedQty,ih.RejectedQty,gm.PutawayQty,um.Alias[Unit]  from GRAPOHeader gh inner join GRAPOMaterial gm on gh.GRNCode=gm.GRNCode inner join Material m on gm.Material=m.MatCode inner join UnitOfMeasure um on gm.Uom=um.UomCode  left join InspectionHeader ih on gm.GRNCode=ih.DocNo and gm.LineCode=ih.DocLine inner join Ledger l on gh.Vendor=l.LedgerCode

/reports/allcfadispatchreport.title: AllCFADispatchReport
tag: SELECT DISTINCT bu.Alias AS [Sending BU],sh.Alias AS [DO No],l.Alias AS [Customer],sh.SODate,PM.PickListCode,PB.Serial,M.Alias AS[Material],PH.PickDate,ph.Vehicle,PB.FIFOReason FROM PickListBarcode PB INNER JOIN PickListMaterial PM ON PB.PickListCode =PM.PickListCode AND PB.RowID = PM.RowID INNER JOIN PickListHeader PH ON PM.PickListCode = PH.PickListCode INNER JOIN SOHeader sh ON sh.SONo = PM.DocNo INNER JOIN Ledger l ON l.LedgerCode = sh.Customer INNER JOIN BusinessUnit bu ON bu.BuCode = sh.BusinessUnit INNER JOIN MATERIAL M ON M.Matcode = PM.Material INNER JOIN Users us ON PB.UserID = us.UserCode

/reports/alldccfaserialstockreport.title: All DC CFA Serial Stock Report
tag: select bu.Alias, m.Alias[Matcodel],m.ProcessID[Material Group],m.Name[Material],sum(mb.CurrentQty)[Qty],u.Alias[Unit] from MaterialBarcode mb left join StorageArea sa on sa.StorageCode = mb.StorageCode inner join Material m on m.MatCode = mb.Material inner join UnitOfMeasure u on u.UomCode = mb.Uom inner join BusinessUnit bu on bu.BuCode=mb.BusinessUnit Where mb.StorageCode !=-1

/reports/audittrailreport.title: Audit Trail Report
tag: select EventID,CONVERT(varchar,EventDate,104)[EventDate],EventTime,u.UserName,DocRef,Module,er.Name[Response],el.Message from EventLog el inner join Users u on el.EventUser=u.UserCode inner join EventActions ac on el.Action=ac.ActionId inner join EventResponse er on el.AppResponse=er.ResponseId  left join BusinessUnit bu on el.BusinessUnit=bu.BuCode

/reports/ceatdispatchpickserialdcreport.title: Pick-Direct Dispatch Serial Wise Report
tag: SELECT DISTINCT bu.Alias AS [SendingDC],sh.Alias AS [DONo],l.Alias AS [Customer],sh.SODate,PM.PickListCode,PB.Serial,M.Alias AS[Material],PH.PickDate,ph.Vehicle,PB.FIFOReason FROM PickListBarcode PB INNER JOIN PickListMaterial PM ON PB.PickListCode =PM.PickListCode AND PB.RowID = PM.RowID INNER JOIN PickListHeader PH ON PM.PickListCode = PH.PickListCode INNER JOIN SOHeader sh ON sh.SONo = PM.DocNo INNER JOIN Ledger l ON l.LedgerCode = sh.Customer INNER JOIN BusinessUnit bu ON bu.BuCode = sh.BusinessUnit INNER JOIN MATERIAL M ON M.Matcode = PM.Material INNER JOIN Users us ON PB.UserID = us.UserCode

/reports/ceatserialwiseproductionstockre.title: Serial Wise Production
tag: select ph.Alias[OrderNo],ph.OrderDate,w.Alias[Station],m.Alias[MatCode],m.Name[Description],b.BarcodeNo[TagCode],b.Serial[Serial],mb.VSerial[Curing SerialNo],bth.Batch,b.Qty,pib.Weight[Carcuss_Weight],b.Weight ,u.UserName[Operator],cast(b.CreatedOn as Date)[ScanDate],cast(b.CreatedOn as time(0))[ScanTime],b.Remark from ProcessOutputBOMBarcode b left join MaterialBarcode mb on b.BarcodeNo=mb.BarcodeNo and b.ProcessCode =mb.ProcessCode inner join ProcessOrder po on b.PSNo =po.PSNo inner join ProcessOutputBOM bom on b.psNo=bom.psno and b.ProcessCode=bom.ProcessCode and b.RowID=bom.RowID left join ProcessInputBOMScan pib on pib.PSNo = b.PSNo and pib.Serial = b.Serial and pib.ProcessCode = b.ProcessCode inner join  ProdHeader ph on po.ProdNo=ph.prodNo inner join WorkCenter w on w.StationCode=b.StationCode inner join Material m on bom.Material =m.MatCode left join MaterialBatch bth on bth.BatchNo = mb.Batch inner join Users u on b.Operator=u.UserCode

/reports/compliancesserialreport.title: Dispatch Report
tag: select distinct bu.Name[BusinessUnit],sum(pm.Qty)[DOQty],sum(pm.PickQty)[Scan Qty], CAST(CASE WHEN SUM(pm.Qty) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (CAST(SUM(pm.PickQty) AS FLOAT) / SUM(pm.Qty)) * 100 END AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS [Scan %] from PickListMaterial Pm inner join SOHeader sh on sh.SONo = pm.DocNo inner join Material m on m.MatCode = pm.Material inner join Ledger l on l.LedgerCode = sh.Customer inner join BusinessUnit bu on bu.BuCode = sh.BusinessUnit

/reports/dcdispatchreport.title: Dispatch Report
tag: select distinct bu.Name[DEALER_NAME] ,l.Name[SHIP_TO_ADDRESS] ,sh.Alias[DONO],pm.PickListCode,m.Alias[FGCODE],m.Name[Material_Name],pm.Qty[DOQty],pm.PickQty[QTY] ,(pm.Qty-pm.PickQty)[Difference] from PickListMaterial Pm inner join SOHeader sh on sh.SONo = pm.DocNo inner join Material m on m.MatCode = pm.Material inner join Ledger l on l.LedgerCode = sh.Customer inner join BusinessUnit bu on bu.BuCode = sh.BusinessUnit

/reports/dcserialstockreport.title: Dc Serial Stock Report
tag: select mb.Serial[Barcode],mb.VSerial[CuringSerialNo],m.Name[Material],m.Alias[MatCode],m.DrawingNo [NOE_Regular_CALM],mc.ParentCategory[Group_Name],m.ProcessID[Material_Group],sa.Alias[StorageCode],s.Status[QCStatus],gp.Alias[DONo],FORMAT(mb.CreatedOn,'dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss')[MFG_Date],Concat(DateDiff(day,mb.CreatedOn,getdate()),' ','days')[MFG_Ageing],Concat(DateDiff(day,mb.LastMaintained,getdate()),' ','days')[WarehouseAging],Concat(DateDiff(day, mb.CreatedOn, getdate()) - DateDiff(day, mb.LastMaintained, getdate()), ' days') AS AgeingDifference ,RIGHT('0' + CAST(DATEPART(ISO_WEEK, mb.CreatedOn) AS VARCHAR), 2) + RIGHT(CAST(YEAR(mb.CreatedOn) AS VARCHAR), 2)AS [WeekCode],case WHEN DateDiff(day, mb.CreatedOn, getdate()) <= 30 THEN '0-30'  WHEN DateDiff(day, mb.CreatedOn, getdate()) > 30 AND DateDiff(day, mb.CreatedOn, getdate()) <= 90 THEN '31-90'  WHEN DateDiff(day, mb.CreatedOn, getdate()) > 90 AND DateDiff(day, mb.CreatedOn, getdate()) <= 180 THEN '91-180' else '180+' end [Ageing_Range] from MaterialBarcode mb left join DocumentType dt on mb.DocType = dt.ID left join Material m on mb.Material = m.MatCode left join MaterialBatch batc on batc.BatchNo= mb.Batch left join StorageArea sa on mb.StorageCode = sa.StorageCode and mb.BusinessUnit = sa.BusinessUnit left join GRAPOHeader gp on gp.GRNCode =mb.DocNo left join UnitOfMeasure u on mb.Uom = u.UomCode left join status s on mb.QCStatus = s.ID left join MaterialBarcode hm on hm.BarcodeNo = mb.HUID left join MaterialCategory mc on mc.Alias=m.ProcessID
Where mb.BusinessUnit=<BU> And mb.StorageCode !=-1 And m.ProcessID in('2015','2020','2090','2095','2100')

/reports/defectreport.title: Defect Report
tag: select qn.Type[Action],dm.Name[Defect],m.Alias[MatCode],m.name[Material],Concat(wc.Name,' ', mp.Name)[Press],sum(it.qty)[Qty] from InspectionTrans it inner join InspectionDefect id on it.ID=id.ID inner join DefectCodeMaster dm on id.Defect=dm.Code inner join QCNextAction qn on it.NextAction=qn.ID inner join InspectionHeader ih on ih.InspectionLotNo=it.InspectionLotNo inner join Material m on ih.Material =m.MatCode left join ProcessOutputBOMBarcode pb on pb.BarcodeNo=it.SampleBarcode left join Material mp on pb.ProcessingUnit=mp.MatCode left join WorkCenter wc on pb.StationCode=wc.StationCode

/reports/dispatchpickserialreport.title: Dispatch Picking Serial Wise Report
tag: select distinct PB.PickListCode, PB.Serial,M.Alias[Material],M.Alias ,cast(PH.PickDate as Date)[PickDate],cast(PH.PickDate as Time(0))[PickTime],PB.Status,OB.OBDCode,OH.Vehicle,OH.Container,PB.FIFOReason,us.UserName from PickListBarcode PB inner join PickListHeader PH on PB.PickListCode = PH.PickListCode INNER JOIN PickListMaterial PM ON PB.PickListCode = PM.PickListCode INNER JOIN MATERIAL M ON M.Matcode = PM.Material left JOIN OBASOBarcode OB ON PB.Serial = OB.Serial INNER JOIN OBASOHeader OH ON OB.OBDCode = OH.OBDCode INNER JOIN Users us ON PB.UserID = us.UserCode

/reports/dispatchreport.title: Dispatch Report
tag: Select sh.Alias[OBDNo],h.OBDDATE,l.Name[Customer] ,h.Container,h.Vehicle,mt.Alias[Mat Code],mt.Name[Material Description],mb.Serial,mb.VSerial[ID Plate]  from OBASOHEADER h inner Join OBASOMaterial m on h.OBDCode=m.OBDCode inner join OBASOBarcode b on h.OBDCode=b.OBDCode and m.OBDCode=b.obdCode and m.ROWID=b.RowID inner join MaterialBarcode mb on b.BarcodeNo=mb.BarcodeNo inner join Material mt on m.Material=mt.MatCode inner join Ledger l on l.LedgerCode=h.Customer inner join SOHeader sh on sh.SONo=m.SONo

/reports/erpproductionposting.title: Production Posting Report
tag: select po.AssignDate,h.Alias[PO],b.Serial,m.Alias[MatCode],m.Name[Material],w.Alias[Station],b.Shift,b.ERPStatus,b.ERPDate from ProcessOutputBOMBarcode b inner join WorkCenter w on b.StationCode=w.StationCode and b.ERPStatus>0 inner join ProcessOutputBOM bm on b.PSNo=bm.PSNo and b.ProcessCode=bm.ProcessCode inner join Material m on bm.Material =m.MatCode inner join ProcessOrder po on po.PSNo =b.PSNo inner join PRODHeader h on po.PRODNo=h.PRODNo

/reports/existingstockprintsummaryreport.title: Existing Stock Print Report
tag: Select format(mb.CreatedOn,'dd-MMM-yyyy')[PrintDate], m.Alias[ItemCode],m.Name[Description],Sum(mb.CurrentQty)[Qty],u.Alias[Unit],a.Alias[SubInv],sa.Alias[BIN]    from MaterialBarcode mb inner join Material m on mb.Material =m.MatCode inner join UnitOfMeasure u on mb.Uom=u.UomCode Left join Area a on mb.Area=a.AreaCode  left join StorageArea sa on mb.StorageCode=sa.StorageCode

/reports/grnreport.title: Goods Reciept Report
tag: Select d.Name[Department],gh.Alias[GRNCode],CONVERT(varchar,gh.GRNDate,104)[Inward Date],CONVERT(varchar,gh.GRNDate,104)[GRNDate], l.Name[Vendor],gm.PONo,m.Name[Material],m.MatCode,gm.ReceivedQty,gm.PrintQty,gm.PutawayQty,u.Alias[Unit] from GRAPOMaterial gm inner join GRAPOHeader gh on gh.GRNCode=gm.GRNCode inner join Material m on gm.Material=m.MatCode inner join UnitOfMeasure u on gm.Uom=u.UomCode inner join Department d on d.DeptCode= gh.Department inner join Ledger l on gh.Vendor=l.LedgerCode

/reports/heldupncmrreport.title: NCMR Report
tag:
SELECT distinct it.Serial,ib.VSerial[ID_Plate],wc.Alias[Station] ,d.Name[Department] ,m.Alias[Material],cast(it.InspectedOn as Date)[Heldup_On_Date],cast(it.InspectedOn as time(0))[Heldup_On_Time],us.UserName [Heldup_By],it.Remark,dct.Alias[DefectCategory],df.Name [Defects],qn.Type[Next_Action] ,us2.UserName[NCMR_Tech_By],cast(it.TNCMROn as date)[NCMR_Tech_On_Date],cast(it.TNCMROn as Time(0))[NCMR_Tech_On_Time],it.TNCMRRemark[NCMR_Tech_Remark],us1.UserName[NCMR_Quality_By]  ,cast(it.NCMROn as Date)[NCMR_Quality_On_Date],cast(it.NCMROn as Time(0))[NCMR_Quality_On_Time] ,it.NCMRRemark[NCMR_Quality_remark] FROM 
                                                        InspectionTrans it 
                                                        inner join  InspectionHeader ih on it.InspectionLotNo = ih.InspectionLotNo 
                                                        inner join Material m on ih.Material = m.MatCode 
                                                        inner join MaterialBarcode ib on ib.Serial = it.Serial 
                                                        inner join ProcessOutputBOMBarcode pb on it.Serial =pb.Serial and ih.DocNo = pb.PSNo 
                                                        inner join WorkCenter wc on pb.StationCode = wc.StationCode and wc.Alias != 'GTWS0001'
                                                        left join Users us on it.UserCode = us.UserCode 
                                                       left join Users us2 on it.TNCMRBy  = us2.UserCode 
                                                        left join Users us1 on it.NCMRBy = us1.UserCode 
                                                        left join InspectionDefect id on it.ID = id.ID
                                                        left join DefectCodeMaster df on df.Code = id.Defect
                                                        left join DefectCategoryType dct on dct.ID = id.Category
                                                        left join Department D  on ih.Department = d.DeptCode
                                                        left join QCNextAction qn on it.NextAction  = qn.ID
                                                        where  it.Status =15

/reports/inspectionreport.title: Quality Inspection Report
tag: select d.Name[Department], i.Alias[InspectionLot],dt.Type[DocumentType],i.DocNo,CONVERT(varchar,i.DocDate,104)[DocDate], it.Type[InspectionType], m.Name[material],i.Qty,i.ApprovedQty,i.RejectedQty,u.Alias[Unit],s.Status  from InspectionHeader i left join DocumentType dt on i.DocType=dt.ID left join Material m on i.Material=m.MatCode left join UnitOfMeasure u on i.Uom =u.UomCode left join department d on i.Department =d.DeptCode left join InspectionType it on i.InspectionType=it.ID   left join Status s on i.Status=s.ID

/reports/inspectionsummaryreport.title: Inspection Summary Report
tag: select ity.Type[Inspection Type], m.Alias[MaterialCode], m.Name[Material Description],sum(it.Qty)TotalQty,s.Status[Status],qn.Type[Action],u.UserName ,u1.UserName[NCMR_Tech_By],u2.UserName[NCMR_Quality_By] from InspectionTrans it inner join InspectionHeader ih on it.InspectionLotNo=ih.InspectionLotNo left join Status s on it.Status=s.ID left join QCNextAction qn on it.NextAction=qn.ID inner join Material m on ih.Material=m.MatCode  inner join Users u on it.UserCode=u.UserCode left join Users u1 on it.TNCMRBy=u1.UserCode left join Users u2 on it.NCMRBy =u2.UserCode left join InspectionType ity on ih.InspectionType=ity.ID

/reports/integrationlogreport.title: Integration Log Report
tag: Select d.Type[Doctype],i.DocNo,i.UpdatedOn,s.Status[Result],i.Message from IntegrationLog i left join DocumentType d on i.DocType =d.ID left join Status s on s.ID =i.Result

/reports/onlinerejectionreport.title: Online Rejection Report
tag: select mat.Name[Material],p.Qty,u.Alias[Unit],m.Serial,l.Name[Vandor],g.InvoiceNo,g.InvoiceDate,p.ScannedOn[RejectedOn],d.Name[Department],wc.Name[Station]   from ProcessOnlineRejection p left join MaterialBarcode m on p.BarcodeNo=m.BarcodeNo left join GRAPOHeader g on m.DocNo =g.GRNCode  left join Material mat on m.Material=mat.MatCode left join UnitOfMeasure u on m.Uom=u.UomCode left join Ledger l on g.Vendor =l.LedgerCode left join Department d on g.Department =d.DeptCode left join WorkCenter wc on wc.StationCode=p.Station

/reports/planvsactualreport.title: Production Plan Vs Actual
tag: select Format(pp.PDate,'dd-MMM-yyyy')[PDate],s.Name[Shift], d.Name[Department],pl.Name[Manf.Line],w.Name[Station],m.Alias[MatCode],m.Name[Material],pp.PlannedQty,pp.AchievedQty,u.Alias[unit],isnull(Cast(Round((100/nullif(pp.PlannedQty,0)*pp.AchievedQty),0) as numeric(18,0)),0)[Percentage]  from ProductionPlan pp inner join Department d on pp.Department=d.DeptCode left join  ProductionLine pl on pp.ManfLine=pl.LineCode left join WorkCenter w on pp.WorkCenter =w.StationCode left join [Shift] s on pp.Shift=s.ShiftCode inner join Material m on pp.Material =m.MatCode inner join UnitOfMeasure u on pp.Uom =u.UomCode

/reports/prnreport.title: Purchase Return Report
tag: Select d.name[Department], gh.Alias[PRNCode],CONVERT(varchar,gh.PRNDate,104)[PRNDate], l.Name[Vendor],gh.InvoiceNo,m.Name[Material],m.MatCode,gm.Qty[OrderQty],ReturnQty,u.Alias[Unit] from PRNMaterial  gm inner join PRNHeader gh on gh.PRNCode=gm.PRNCode left join Material m on gm.Material=m.MatCode left join UnitOfMeasure u on gm.Uom=u.UomCode left join Department d on d.DeptCode= gh.Department left join Ledger l on gh.Vendor=l.LedgerCode

/reports/productionactivityreport.title: Production Activity Report
tag: select m.Name[FG],pa.PSNo,wc.Name[Station],at.Type[Activity],pa.ActivityOn,u.UserName,pa.Remark,br.Type [Reason]  from ProcessActivity pa left join ProcessActivityType at on pa.ActivityType=at.ID left join WorkCenter wc on pa.StationCode =wc.StationCode left join Users u on u.UserCode =pa.Operator left join BreakDownReasons br on pa.Reason=br.ID  left join ProcessOrder po on pa.PSNo=po.PSNo left join Material m on po.Material=m.MatCode

/reports/rmissuesummery.title: RM Issue Summery Report
tag: select distinct TH.LTODATE[Date], TH.Alias [MaterialRequisition],M.Alias[MaterialCode],M.Name, TM.Qty[Plan(KG)],TM.DQty[IssuedQTY(KG)] from TOMaterial TM inner join Material M on TM.Material = M.Matcode INNER JOIN TOHeader TH on TM.LTOCODE = TM.LTOcode

/reports/serialinoutscanhistoryreport.title: Serial In-Out Scan Report
tag: select ph.Alias[PO],w.Alias[Station],pp.Name [Process], pi.Serial,pi.ScannedOn[Inscan],ui.UserName[Operator],po.CreatedOn[OutScan] from ProcessInputBOMScan pi left join ProcessOutputBOMBarcode po on pi.PSNo=po.PSNo and pi.StationCode =po.StationCode and pi.Serial=po.Serial inner join ProcessOrder p on p.PSNo=pi.PSNo inner join PRODHeader ph on p.PRODNo=ph.PRODNo inner join WorkCenter w on pi.StationCode=w.StationCode  inner join ProductionProcess pp on pp.ProcessCode =pi.ProcessCode left join Users ui on pi.Operator =ui.UserCode

/reports/serialinspectionreport.title: Serial Wise Inspection Report
tag: select CONVERT(varchar(10),CAST(it.InspectedOn as date),105) as Date,CONVERT(varchar,it.InspectedOn,108)AS Time, ity.Type[Inspection Type],it.Serial,qn.Type[NextAction],DCT.Alias[DefectCategory],DF.Alias[DefectCode],DF.Name[DefectName] ,m.Alias[MaterialCode], m.Name[Material Description],s.Status[Status],it.ERPMessage[Middle_RunOut],case when it.DistortionStatus=1 then 'Ok' when it.DistortionStatus=9 then 'Not Ok' end as DistortionStatus ,it.ODValue,qn.Type[Action],u.UserName,u1.UserName[NCMR_Tech_By],u2.UserName[NCMR_Quality_By],it.remark from InspectionTrans it inner join InspectionHeader ih on it.InspectionLotNo=ih.InspectionLotNo left join Status s on it.Status=s.ID left join QCNextAction qn on it.NextAction=qn.ID left join InspectionDefect ID on it.ID = id.ID left join DefectCodeMaster DF on ID.Defect=DF.Code left join DefectCategoryType DCT on ID.Category=DCT.ID inner join Material m on ih.Material=m.MatCode inner join Users u on it.UserCode=u.UserCode left join Users u1 on it.TNCMRBy=u1.UserCode left join Users u2 on it.NCMRBy =u2.UserCode left join InspectionType ity on ih.InspectionType=ity.ID

/reports/serialprodmixingreport.title: Serial Wise Stock
tag: select ph.Alias[OrderNo],ph.OrderDate,w.Alias[Station],m.Alias[MatCode],m.Name[Description] ,sum(bth.NoOfBatchs) as No_Of_Batchs,Sum(mb.CurrentQty) as Total_Qty from ProcessOutputBOMBarcode b inner join MaterialBarcode mb on b.BarcodeNo=mb.BarcodeNo inner join ProcessOrder po on b.PSNo =po.PSNo inner join ProcessOutputBOM bom on b.psNo=bom.psno and b.ProcessCode=bom.ProcessCode and b.RowID=bom.RowID inner join  ProdHeader ph on po.ProdNo=ph.prodNo inner join WorkCenter w on w.StationCode=b.StationCode inner join Material m on bom.Material =m.MatCode left join MaterialBatch bth on bth.BatchNo = mb.Batch inner join Users u on b.Operator=u.UserCode

/reports/serialprodmixingreport_old.title: Serial Wise Production
tag: select ph.Alias[OrderNo],ph.OrderDate,w.Alias[Station],m.Alias[MatCode],m.Name[Description],mb.Serial[Barcode],mb.VSerial[IDPlate],bth.Batch,mb.CurrentQty,b.Weight ,u.UserName[Operator],Format(b.CreatedOn,'dd-MMM-yy HH:mm:ss')[ScanTime],b.Remark from ProcessOutputBOMBarcode b inner join MaterialBarcode mb on b.BarcodeNo=mb.BarcodeNo inner join ProcessOrder po on b.PSNo =po.PSNo inner join ProcessOutputBOM bom on b.psNo=bom.psno and b.ProcessCode=bom.ProcessCode and b.RowID=bom.RowID inner join  ProdHeader ph on po.ProdNo=ph.prodNo inner join WorkCenter w on w.StationCode=b.StationCode inner join Material m on bom.Material =m.MatCode left join MaterialBatch bth on bth.BatchNo = mb.Batch inner join Users u on b.Operator=u.UserCode

/reports/serialstockreport.title: Serial Wise Stock
tag: select mb.Serial[Barcode],mb.VSerial[IDPlate],m.Name[Material],m.Alias[MatCode],hm.Serial[MHE],sa.Alias[StorageCode],d.Name[Department],s.Status[QCStatus], batc.Batch,mb.CurrentQty,u.Alias[Unit],isnull(dt.Type,'')[Document],mb.CreatedOn,Concat(DateDiff(day,mb.CreatedOn,getdate()),' ','days')[Ageing]  from MaterialBarcode mb left join DocumentType dt on mb.DocType=dt.ID left join Material m on mb.Material=m.MatCode left join Department d on mb.Department=d.DeptCode left join StorageArea sa on mb.StorageCode=sa.StorageCode left join MaterialBatch batc on batc.BatchNo= mb.Batch left join UnitOfMeasure u on mb.Uom=u.UomCode left join status s on mb.QCStatus=s.ID left join MaterialBarcode hm on hm.BarcodeNo =mb.HUID

/reports/serialwiseproductionorderreport.title: Serial Wise Production
tag: select distinct ph.Alias[OrderNo],ph.OrderDate,w.Alias[Station],m.Alias[MatCode],m.Name[Description],b.BarcodeNo[TagCode],b.Serial[Serial],mb.VSerial[Curing SerialNo],po.Remark[Spec_Weight],b2.Weight[Carcuss_Weight] ,b1.Weight,bth.Batch,b.Qty ,u.UserName[Operator],cast(b.CreatedOn as Date)[ScanDate],cast(b.CreatedOn as time(0))[ScanTime],b.Remark,CASE WHEN b.WeightFlg = 1 THEN 'Manual' ELSE 'Auto' END AS WeightMode from ProcessOutputBOMBarcode b inner join MaterialBarcode mb on b.Serial  = mb.Serial inner join ProcessOrder po on b.PSNo = po.PSNo left join ProcessOutputBOMBarcode b1 on b.Serial = b1.Serial and b1.ProcessCode =12213 left join ProcessInputBOMScan  b2 on b.Serial = b2.Serial and b2.ProcessCode =12213 inner join ProcessOutputBOM bom on b.psNo = bom.psno and b.ProcessCode = bom.ProcessCode and b.RowID = bom.RowID left join ProcessInputBOMScan pib on pib.PSNo = b.PSNo and pib.Serial = b.Serial and pib.ProcessCode = b.ProcessCode inner join  ProdHeader ph on po.ProdNo = ph.prodNo inner join WorkCenter w on w.StationCode = b.StationCode inner join Material m on bom.Material = m.MatCode left join MaterialBatch bth on bth.BatchNo = mb.Batch inner join Users u on b.Operator = u.UserCode

/reports/stockmhereport.title: Material Stock Report
tag: select mb1.Serial[MHE],sa.Name[Location],m.Name[Material],sum(mb.CurrentQty)[Qty],u.Alias[Unit],d.Name[Department]  from MaterialBarcode mb inner join  Material m on m.MatCode=mb.Material and mb.StorageCode>0  inner join UnitOfMeasure u on mb.Uom =u.UomCode left join MaterialBarcode mb1 on mb.HUID=mb1.BarcodeNo  inner join StorageArea sa on mb.StorageCode=sa.StorageCode  inner join Department d on mb.Department =d.DeptCode

/reports/stockreport.title: Material Stock Report
tag: select sa.Alias[Storage_Location],m.Alias[Matcodel],m.Name[Material],sum(mb.CurrentQty)[Qty],u.Alias[Unit] ,mb.BusinessUnit from MaterialBarcode mb left join StorageArea sa on sa.StorageCode = mb.StorageCode inner join Material m on m.MatCode = mb.Material inner join UnitOfMeasure u on u.UomCode = mb.Uom

/reports/tmeicreports/tmginreport.title: Goods Reciept Report
tag: Select gh.GENCode,gh.GENDate,gh.InvoiceNo, l.Name[Vendor],po.Alias[PoNo],pm.RowID[PoLine],m.Alias[ItemCode],m.Name[Description],gm.ReceivedQty,um.Alias[Unit],s.Status  from GEAPOHeader  gh inner join GEAPOMaterial  gm on gh.GENCode =gm.GENCode inner join POMaterial pm on gm.PoNo=pm.PONo and gm.PoLineCode=pm.RowID inner join Material m on gm.Material=m.MatCode inner join UnitOfMeasure um on gm.Uom=um.UomCode   inner join POHeader po on pm.PONo=po.PONo inner join Ledger l on gh.Vendor=l.LedgerCode  left join Status s on gh.Status=s.ID

/reports/tmeicreports/tmgrnreport.title: Goods Reciept Report
tag: Select gh.GRNCode,gh.ERPGRNCode,gh.GENCode,gh.GRNDate,gh.InvoiceNo, l.Name[Vendor],po.Alias[PoNo],pm.RowID[PoLine],m.Alias[ItemCode],m.Name[Description],gm.ReceivedQty,gm.PrintQty,ih.ApprovedQty,ih.RejectedQty,gm.PutawayQty,um.Alias[Unit],s.Status  from GRAPOHeader gh inner join GRAPOMaterial gm on gh.GRNCode=gm.GRNCode inner join POMaterial pm on gm.PoNo=pm.PONo and gm.PoLineCode=pm.RowID inner join Material m on gm.Material=m.MatCode inner join UnitOfMeasure um on gm.Uom=um.UomCode   inner join POHeader po on pm.PONo=po.PONo left join InspectionHeader ih on gm.GRNCode=ih.DocNo and gm.LineCode=ih.DocLine inner join Ledger l on gh.Vendor=l.LedgerCode  left join Status s on gh.Status=s.ID

/reports/tmeicreports/tminspectionreport.title: Inspection Report
tag: Select ih.DocNo[GRNNo],ih.DocLine[Line], ph.Alias[PoNo],gm.PoLineCode[PoLine],m.Alias[ItemCode],m.Name[Description],gm.ReceivedQty[GRNQty],ih.ApprovedQty,ih.RejectedQty,um.Alias[Unit], ih.DocDate[GRNDate], it.InspectedOn,it.Qty, qn.Type[NextAction] from InspectionHeader ih inner join InspectionTrans it on ih.InspectionLotNo=it.InspectionLotNo inner join GRAPOMaterial gm on ih.DocNo=gm.GRNCode and ih.DocLine=gm.LineCode inner join POHeader ph on gm.PoNo=ph.PONo inner join Material m on gm.Material=m.MatCode inner join UnitOfMeasure um on gm.Uom=um.UomCode left join QCNextAction qn on qn.ID=it.NextAction

/reports/tmeicreports/tmjoborderissuerep.title: Job Order Report
tag: Select lh.Alias[JobOrder],lh.LTODate[Date],m.Alias[ItemCode],m.Name[Description],lm.Qty[OrderQty],lm.TQty[PickedQty],lm.DQty[DropQty],lm.RQty[ReceiveQty],lm.IQty[PostQty],um.Alias[Unit],a.Alias[From SubInv],CONCAT(a.alias, '.', p.Alias, '.', t.Alias)[Locator],a1.Alias[To SubInv] from LTOHeader lh inner join LTOMaterial lm on lh.LTOCode=lm.LTOCode inner join Material m on lm.Material=m.MatCode inner join UnitOfMeasure um on lm.Uom=um.UomCode left join Project p on p.ProjectCode=lm.Project left join Task t on t.TaskCode=lm.Task left join Area a on a.AreaCode=lm.FromArea left join Area a1 on a1.AreaCode=lm.ToArea

/reports/toserialreport.title: RM Issue Serial Wise Report
tag: select distinct th.Alias[MR],ma.Alias[Material],ma.Name[Description],tm.Qty[Reservation_Qty],tb.Qty[Picked_Qty],th.LTODate[MR_Date],tb.Serial[Barcode_No] ,gm.ManufBatch[Batch_No]  ,gh.Alias[GRN_No],tb.ScanDate,us.UserName ,tb.Status ,tb.ERPMessage from TOBarcode tb inner join TOHeader th on tb.LTOCode = th.LTOCode inner join TOMaterial tm on tb.LTOCode = tm.LTOCode and tb.RowID = tm.RowID inner join MaterialBarcode mb on tb.BarcodeNo = mb.BarcodeNo inner join Material ma on mb.Material = ma.MatCode left join GRAPOMaterial gm on mb.DocNo = gm.GRNCode and mb.DocLine = gm.LineCode left join GRAPOHeader gh on gm.GRNCode = gh.GRNCode left join Users us on tb.UserId = us.UserCode

/reports/workstationreport.title: Work Station Report
tag: Select sa.Name[Storage],mty.Type [Type], m.Alias[MatCode],m.Name[Material],ms.Qty,ms.ReleasedQty,ms.HoldQty,ms.RejectedQty,ms.ReserveQty,u.Alias[Unit],d.Name[Department],mb.Batch,mb.ExpiryDate from MaterialStock ms left join Material m on ms.Material =m.MatCode left join UnitOfMeasure u  on ms.Uom =u.UomCode left join Department d on ms.Department =d.DeptCode left join StorageArea sa on ms.StorageCode =sa.StorageCode left join MaterialBatch mb on ms.Batch=mb.BatchNo  left join MaterialCategoryType mty on mty.ID =m.Type

/reports/workstationyieldreport.title: Production Output Report
tag: select w.Alias[Station],m.Alias[Material],m.Name[Description],sum(b.qty) Qty,u.Alias[Unit],us.UserName[Operator] from ProcessOutputBOMBarcode b inner join ProcessOutputBOM  p on b.PSNo=p.PSNo and b.ProcessCode=p.ProcessCode inner join Material m on p.Material =m.MatCode inner join UnitOfMeasure u on m.BaseUom=u.UomCode LEFT join WorkCenter w on b.StationCode= w.StationCode left join ProductionProcess prs on prs.ProcessCode= b.ProcessCode left join Users us on b.Operator=us.UserCode

/reports/wrlreports/productiontracebilit.title: Production Tracebility Report
tag: Select po.PRODNo[Prodution Order],m.Name[Model name],poAs.Serial[Ref SRNo], poAs.CreatedOn[Ref Creation Date],mb.Serial[FG Serial No],mb.CreatedOn[FG Creation Date],mb.VSerial[Asset Tag],typ.Type[Component Type],mai.Name [Component Name],mai.MatCode[Component Code],poIn.Serial[Component Barcode],poin.ScannedOn,l.Name[Supplier Name] from (ProcessOrder po inner join Material m on po.Material=m.MatCode inner join ProcessOutputBOMBarcode poAs on po.PSNo=poAs.PSNo and poAs.ProcessCode=12203 left join MaterialBarcode mb on mb.DocNo=po.PSNo and mb.Material=po.Material and Po.Status=10 and mb.Status != 99 ) left join ProcessInputBOMScan poIn on po.PSNo=poIn.PSNo and poin.ProcessCode=12203 left join Material mai on poin.Material=mai.MatCode left join MaterialCategoryType typ on typ.ID=mai.Type left join  Ledger l on mai.ledger =l.LedgerCode

/reports/wrlreports/reworkdata.title: Production Tracebility Report
tag:
select m.Alias[Model_Name],mc.Name[Category],w.Name[Station],it.Serial[Assembly Sr.No.],pr.StartedOn[Rework IN], pr.CompletedOn[Rework Out] ,s.Status[Rework Status],
                                                  CONCAT(DATEDIFF(day, pr.StartedOn, pr.CompletedOn),   ':',FORMAT((DATEDIFF(minute, pr.StartedOn, pr.CompletedOn)/60)%24,'D2'),    ':',FORMAT(DATEDIFF(minute,pr.StartedOn, pr.CompletedOn) % 60,'D2'))[Duration (DD,HH:MM)] ,
                                                  dct.Type[Defect Category] ,dc.Name[Defect],rc.Type[Root Cause], rr.Type[Counter Action] 
                                                  from InspectionTrans it inner join InspectionHeader ih on it.InspectionLotNo = ih.InspectionLotNo and it.NextAction =1
                                                  inner join Material m on ih.Material = m.MatCode 
                                                  left join MaterialCategory mc on m.Category = mc.CategoryCode
                                                  inner join ProcessRouting pr on ih.DocNo = pr.PSNo
                                                  left join WorkCenter w on pr.StationCode = w.StationCode 
                                                  left join Status s on ih.Status = s.id 
                                                  left join InspectionDefect id on it.ID = id.ID 
                                                  left join DefectCodeMaster dc on id.Defect = dc.Code 
                                                  left join DefectCategoryType dct on dc.DefectCategory = dct.ID
                                                  left join RootCause rc on it.RootCause = rc.ID 
                                                  left join ReworkResolution rr on it.ReworkResolution = rr.ID

/reports/wrlreports/topdefects.title: Top Defect Report
tag: select format(it.inspectedOn,'dd-MMM-yyyy')[InspectedOn],dm.Name[Defect],m.Alias[MatCode],CAST(sum(it.qty) as bigint)[Qty],rc.Type[RootCause] from InspectionTrans it inner join InspectionDefect id on it.ID=id.ID inner join DefectCodeMaster dm on id.Defect=dm.Code inner join InspectionHeader ih on ih.InspectionLotNo=it.InspectionLotNo inner join Material m on ih.Material =m.MatCode left join RootCause  rc on it.RootCause = rc.ID
group by dm.Name,m.Alias,rc.Type, format(it.inspectedOn,'dd-MMM-yyyy') order by sum(it.qty) desc
